title: Stats and First Match
prompt: Implement `total(scores)` (sum of all elements), `average(scores)` (0 when empty), and `first_below(scores, limit)` returning the INDEX of the first element below limit, or -1 if none.

tests.name: average empty
tests.hint: Empty input must give 0, not a division by zero.

tests.name: first match
tests.hint: Index 1 holds the first value below 6.
